The Analytical Quality and Assurance function owns and maintains this playbook. It decides what changes after publication.

## Suggesting a change

Send a change as a pull request. [How to contribute](CONTRIBUTE.md) explains how to raise it and how to send it.

To raise something that is not a change to the text, go to the Analytical Quality and Assurance function. [Who to ask](guidance/09-resources/r3-who-to-ask.qmd) lists who to contact for everything else.
